verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking into the Mesh guides. The doc pages themselves are served as .md markdown URLs, so an agent can be pointed at the docs directly. The .md.md 404 is only a malformed double-suffix probe and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
